# Heap checks must preserve the no-stack-growth contract after fork.
[short] skip
go build -gcflags=syscall=-d=isolateheap=2 -o fork.exe .
env GOGC=1
exec ./fork.exe
stdout '^fork checks passed$'
[race] go build -race -gcflags=syscall=-d=isolateheap=2 -o fork-race.exe .
[race] exec ./fork-race.exe
[race] stdout '^fork checks passed$'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/isolatefork
go 1.26

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) > 1 {
		fmt.Println("child")
		return
	}
	binary, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	for range 8 {
		output, err := exec.Command(binary, "child").CombinedOutput()
		if err != nil || string(output) != "child\n" { panic(fmt.Sprintf("fork: %v %s", err, output)) }
	}
	fmt.Println("fork checks passed")
}
